what_this_is: The ic tool programme's baseline ledger as data (IC_TOOL_PROGRAM.md §7). Each accepted round appends a baseline; none is ever edited.
unit: S = time / (unit_ns × √r); unit_ns is v0's median batched addition at each size, pinned from R01 (IC_TOOL_PROGRAM.md §5)

pinned_r10.what_this_is: Repair R10 (docs/audits/REPAIR_FRAMEWORK_20261016.md): the incumbent each IC round must compare against, per curve family and size, pinned 2026-10-19 from main at cb2ec6873. From this pin on, a round names the entry below (track and size) as its incumbent; it never picks its own. An accepted round appends a new entry to its track; no entry is edited. The baselines array below stays the ic tool programme's own ledger.
pinned_r10.derivation: research/ic_tool_program/ledger/r10-20261019/rerate.sh (jq and awk over the committed raw records; nothing re-run)
rules: Cost: a candidate's paired ratio is taken against the pinned configuration of its track at each size it measures, on the same instances; a round that cannot run the pinned configuration says so and is reported as unmatched.
Exponent: where a track pins an exponent reference, a fitted-exponent claim is stated against it over the same range.
Distance to rho: every row carries the gap to the matched rho named in its entry; the gap is the distance remaining, not a gate (AGENTS.md, success criterion).

Units: s_cold, s_setup and s_online are in each entry's own unit, named in its unit field. Only the suite track and kob-orbit-v1's s_*_ledger fields use the ledger's S (unit_ns × √r); a cross-host value in that unit is marked as such and never ranks two arms.

per_curve_best.note: Where two pipelines run on the same ICV1 curve, the curve's best measured IC is the one with the smaller gap to its own matched rho. On k0n41, k0n53 and k0n61 that is the ic tool programme's pipeline, not the compact-orbit example (kob-orbit-v1): 7.66 / 13.24 / 20.97 times rho cold at rule v3 on main against 9.5 / 24.9 / 48.4 for the compact-orbit default (cross-run wall against item 09's strong rho).
per_curve_best.suite_sizes: baselines[] v3 (R07, 995ea207) on main; rule v3 for the one-target cold comparison (research/ic_tool_program/rule/v3/analysis.json). Open PRs #1978/#2277 append v4-v8 (R10, R06, R08, R11, R12) and rule v7 (3.43-11.51 times rho cold); they become the pin for these sizes when merged, by appending to baselines[] as the programme's rule already requires.
